## Before submitting

- [x] I agree to license this contribution under the terms of [LICENSE.txt](https://github.com/NVIDIA/cudnn-frontend/blob/develop/LICENSE.txt).
- [x] I ran `pre-commit run` and committed any formatting changes.
- [x] I reviewed the Hard Rules in the `AGENTS.md` for each directory this PR touches (Rule 7 -- the DSL gate, Rule 9 -- one caller contract; Rule S2 -- no Capabilities change) and my changes comply.
- [x] Labels: `cat-feature`, `area:frost`, `orig-nv-eng`.

## Affected area

Python API or bindings (the public surface of the graph API and of `cudnn.frost`; no kernel, no engine row, no C++).

## Summary

FlashInfer's cuDNN backend (`flashinfer/cudnn/{prefill,decode,utils}.py`) reads a handful of frontend facts before it routes work to this package: the native SDPA binder's `supports_*` flags (`cudnn._pybind_module._SdpaThdBinder.supports_stats_stride_override` / `.supports_nonpaged_packed_split`), `graph.selected_engine` and its `.name` against the FROST engine names, `graph.backend_plan_entries()`, the CuTe DSL gate in `cudnn.frost.buffers` (`cutedsl_state` / `cutedsl_too_old` / `CUTEDSL_MIN_VERSION`) and `cudnn.datatypes._torch_to_cudnn_data_type`. A private name consumed outside this package is still a caller boundary (`python/cudnn/AGENTS.md` Rule 9), so this PR keeps every one of them as spelled and gives each a public twin:

| what the caller asks | kept as spelled | public spelling (new) |
|---|---|---|
| does the native SDPA binder honor a packed-split / stride contract? | `_SdpaThdBinder.supports_<cap>` (static `True` properties) | `cudnn.sdpa_capabilities() -> frozenset[str]`: every `supports_<cap>` flag of the build, as `<cap>`; append-only; empty on a build without the binder |
| can the FROST engines run on this install, for this GPU? | `cudnn.frost.buffers.cutedsl_state()` / `cutedsl_too_old()` / `CUTEDSL_MIN_VERSION` (the version half) | `cudnn.frost.cutedsl_runtime_available(device_cc=None) -> bool`: the engines' own gate as a probe -- the version half from package metadata, plus, given a `(major, minor)` cc, the target half (`cutedsl_arch_requirement_error`) |
| the cuDNN dtype of a torch dtype | `cudnn.datatypes._torch_to_cudnn_data_type` | `cudnn.datatypes.torch_to_cudnn_data_type` (the private name is an alias of it) |
| which engine serves the selected plan; is the backend still reachable? | `graph.selected_engine`, `graph.backend_plan_entries()` | unchanged; documented as public API, with the engine names `sdpa_fwd_prefill_sm100` / `_sm107` / `_sm120` as stable identifiers (manifest names and slots are append-only) |
| the caller hints | `cudnn.pygraph(is_override_shape_enabled=, is_cuda_graph_replay_expected=)`, `cudnn.graph(**graph_kwargs)` | unchanged; documented on the class |

Also: a "Consumed by FlashInfer" section in `docs/utilities/python_graph_and_execution_backends.md`; the API index gains the module `cudnn.frost` and the rows `cudnn.frost.cutedsl_runtime_available` / `cudnn.sdpa_capabilities`; Rule 9 in `python/cudnn/AGENTS.md` names the pin test.

## Why

**The runtime probe is arch-aware on purpose.** The DSL floor every FROST row declines under is 4.7.0 everywhere, but the cc 10.7 rows additionally need a DSL whose `Arch` knows `sm_107a` -- the public 4.8.0 wheel is the first -- and that gate lives in `cutedsl_arch_requirement_error`, not in the version check. A device-blind probe (the formula a caller can spell today from `cutedsl_state` / `cutedsl_too_old`) therefore reads True on a cc 10.7 part with a 4.7.x DSL while every FROST row declines, and a performance-driven routing decision made on it would send the graph to the backend engine. `cutedsl_runtime_available(device_cc=cc)` closes that blind spot: `device_cc=None` keeps the version-only answer, a cc applies the target half; a cc that is not a pair of integers is a `TypeError` (a `10.5` must not read as cc 10). The DSL is imported only for a cc 10.7 part.

**The names are pinned where a rename would be noticed.** `test/python/sdpa/frost/test_flashinfer_consumed_surface.py` (host-only, L0, no DSL needed) asserts each spelling above still resolves with its signature -- the binder flags as static `True` properties on the class, `sdpa_capabilities()` as their public spelling (every member with a `supports_` twin), `selected_engine` a property and `backend_plan_entries(self)` a query, the two `pygraph` hints with their parameter kinds and defaults plus `**kwargs` on `cudnn.graph` (the probe FlashInfer runs for the replay hint), the three engine names at their manifest slots, the DSL gate names and `CUTEDSL_MIN_VERSION == (4, 7, 0)`, the dtype mapping as one function object behind both spellings, a fresh-interpreter probe that `import cudnn` + the public probes pull neither torch nor the DSL, and the docs section naming every public spelling. The arch-aware cells pin the DSL state exactly where the engines read it: absent / 4.6.2 -> False everywhere; 4.7.1 and 4.7.0rc1 without `sm_107a` -> True blind and on cc 8.0 / 10.0, **False on cc 10.7**; 4.8.0 with `sm_107a` -> True on cc 10.7; an internal build without the target -> True blind, False on cc 10.7; a list spells the same part; the DSL is asked only for a cc 10.7 part. A rename of any consumed name now fails this repository's CI instead of silently degrading a downstream integration to its fallback path.

## Related issues

None.

## API and compatibility impact

- New public names: `cudnn.sdpa_capabilities()`, `cudnn.frost.cutedsl_runtime_available(device_cc=None)`, `cudnn.datatypes.torch_to_cudnn_data_type`. Every existing name is kept; `_torch_to_cudnn_data_type` is an alias of the public function (one object). Signatures are append-only.
- `import cudnn` stays as cheap as before: +42 modules in a fresh interpreter, neither torch nor the DSL, measured identical before and after; `import cudnn.frost` +43; the capability set is read off the compiled binder; the device-blind probe and a non-cc-10.7 part read package metadata only.
- No `Capabilities` / `EngineSpec` change (Rule S2 not triggered): the probes report what the engines already decide. No numerics, no kernel, no C++ change. No new dependency.

## Testing

Host (an A100, cc 8.0; cudnn-frontend 1.32.0 on cuDNN 9.27, nvidia-cutlass-dsl 4.8.0), every run a fresh process with `cudnn` resolving to the PR's tree:

- `pytest -q -o addopts= sdpa/frost/test_flashinfer_consumed_surface.py core/test_import_boundaries.py api_index/test_api_index.py` -> **70 passed, 1 skipped** (the skip is the API-index runtime baseline check, which needs a built wheel) on the PR branch; the pin module alone 34 passed.
- RED half of the pin module against the unmodified tree: **20 failed** (every cell of a new name: `AttributeError` on `sdpa_capabilities` / `cutedsl_runtime_available` / `torch_to_cudnn_data_type`), **14 passed** (every cell of a kept spelling); GREEN 34 / 34 with the change.
- `pytest -q -o addopts= core/` on the development branch carrying the same two commits: 427 passed, 78 skipped, 5 failed -- the 5 are pre-existing on this host under the same environment (two cells assert the FROST opt-in flag is unset, which the local run exports; one needs cuDNN 9.27 headers; one serialization mismatch of the local build) or pass when the module runs alone (a shared-GPU clash between concurrent sessions); none touches the edited paths. `sdpa/frost/test_sdpa_backend_guard.py` 35 passed.
- The API index: the scanner over `cudnn` + `cudnn.frost` against this tree produces exactly the three new rows and nothing else new (the local debug extension lacks the optional `causal_conv1d_*` / `gnn_agg_*` symbols; the CI wheel carries them).
- `pre-commit run --files <the touched files>`: black, black-jupyter, SPDX header passed.

+def sdpa_capabilities() -> frozenset:
+    """Names of the SDPA binding capabilities this build of cudnn-frontend provides, as a frozenset of ``str``.
+
+    Each name ``<cap>`` is a ``supports_<cap>`` flag of the native SDPA binder (``_SdpaThdBinder``): a packed (THD)
+    split or stride contract the compiled extension honors -- ``"stats_stride_override"``, ``"nonpaged_packed_split"``,
+    ``"paged_split_sink"``, ... A caller that needs one asks ``"<cap>" in cudnn.sdpa_capabilities()``; the binder's
+    flags stay as they are, so a caller written against them keeps working. The set is append-only: a capability is
+    never renamed or removed. Empty on a build without the binder. Host Python only: no device, no framework import.

+    "supports_paged_split_sink",
+    "supports_paged_d64_packed_split",
+    "supports_paged_d256_packed_split",
+    "supports_nonpaged_d256_packed_split",
+    "supports_nonpaged_d128_packed_split",

+        assert name in family.slots, f"{name} left the manifest: FlashInfer compares selected_engine.name against it"

+        engine = manifest.engine_for_id(family.engine_id + slot)
+        assert engine is not None and engine.name == name, (name, engine)
+
+
+def test_unified_implementation_graph_helpers_and_decline_type_resolve():
+    assert cudnn.attention_implementation.UNIFIED is not None
+    assert cudnn.heur_mode.A is not None
+    assert issubclass(cudnn.cudnnGraphNotSupportedError, Exception)
+    assert callable(cudnn.graph_cache) and callable(cudnn.jit) and callable(cudnn.graph)
+    for name in ("graph_cache", "jit", "graph", "pygraph", "attention_implementation", "heur_mode", "cudnnGraphNotSupportedError"):
+        assert name in cudnn.__all__, name
+
+
+# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
+# The CuTe DSL gate: the names FlashInfer reads today and the arch-aware public probe
+# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+
+def test_dsl_gate_names_resolve_as_spelled():
+    assert buffers.CUTEDSL_MIN_VERSION == (4, 7, 0)
+    assert list(inspect.signature(buffers.cutedsl_state).parameters) == []
+    assert list(inspect.signature(buffers.cutedsl_too_old).parameters) == ["version"]
+    assert list(inspect.signature(buffers.cutedsl_arch_requirement_error).parameters) == ["device_cc"]
+    assert list(inspect.signature(buffers.cutedsl_requirement_error).parameters) == ["what"]
+    installed, version = buffers.cutedsl_state()
+    assert isinstance(installed, bool)
+    assert version is None or (isinstance(version, tuple) and len(version) == 2)
+
+
+def test_cutedsl_runtime_available_signature_and_export():
+    params = inspect.signature(cudnn.frost.cutedsl_runtime_available).parameters
+    assert list(params) == ["device_cc"] and params["device_cc"].default is None
+    assert "cutedsl_runtime_available" in cudnn.frost.__all__
+
+
+def test_device_blind_probe_equals_the_version_gate_flashinfer_spells_today():
+    """On this install, the device-blind form is exactly FlashInfer's current formula over the frontend's own gate."""
+    installed, version = buffers.cutedsl_state()
+    assert cudnn.frost.cutedsl_runtime_available() is (bool(installed) and not buffers.cutedsl_too_old(version))
+
+
+@pytest.fixture
+def dsl_state(monkeypatch):
+    """Pin the DSL state where the engines read it: the metadata pair and the sm_107a target probe."""
+
+    def pin(installed, version, has_sm107):
+        monkeypatch.setattr(buffers, "_DSL_STATE", (installed, version))
+        monkeypatch.setattr(buffers, "_cutedsl_has_sm107", lambda: has_sm107)
+
+    return pin
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "label, installed, version, has_sm107, blind, cc100, cc107",
+    [
+        ("dsl absent", False, None, False, False, False, False),
+        ("4.6.2 (the downstream floor, below ours)", True, (PUBLIC_DSL, "4.6.2"), False, False, False, False),
+        ("4.7.1 without sm_107a", True, (PUBLIC_DSL, "4.7.1"), False, True, True, False),
+        ("4.7.0rc1 without sm_107a", True, (PUBLIC_DSL, "4.7.0rc1"), False, True, True, False),
+        ("4.8.0 with sm_107a", True, (PUBLIC_DSL, "4.8.0"), True, True, True, True),
+        ("internal build without sm_107a", True, ("nvidia-cutlass-dsl-internal", "0.3.0+2026"), False, True, True, False),
+    ],
+)
+def test_cutedsl_runtime_available_is_arch_aware(dsl_state, label, installed, version, has_sm107, blind, cc100, cc107):
+    """The floor is 4.7.0 everywhere and 4.8.0 on cc 10.7: the (10, 7) + 4.7.x row is the cell a device-blind probe
+    cannot see -- it reads True there while every FROST row declines."""
+    dsl_state(installed, version, has_sm107)
+    probe = cudnn.frost.cutedsl_runtime_available
+    assert probe() is blind, label
+    assert probe(None) is blind, label
+    assert probe((8, 0)) is cc100, label  # no target gate below cc 10.7
+    assert probe((10, 0)) is cc100, label
+    assert probe((10, 7)) is cc107, label
+    assert probe([10, 7]) is cc107, label  # a list spells the same part
+
+
+def test_the_blind_spot_cell_cc107_with_a_47x_dsl(dsl_state):
+    dsl_state(True, (PUBLIC_DSL, "4.7.1"), False)
+    assert cudnn.frost.cutedsl_runtime_available() is True
+    assert cudnn.frost.cutedsl_runtime_available((10, 7)) is False
+    # The same install answers the engines' own gate the same way: the probe IS their decision.
+    assert buffers.cutedsl_arch_requirement_error((10, 7)) is not None
+    assert buffers.cutedsl_arch_requirement_error((10, 0)) is None
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("bad", [(10, 7, 0), (10,), 107, "10.7", (10.5, 7)])
+def test_cutedsl_runtime_available_refuses_a_malformed_cc(dsl_state, bad):
+    """A cc that is not a pair of integers is refused, never silently read as 'not cc 10.7'."""
+    dsl_state(True, (PUBLIC_DSL, "4.7.1"), False)
+    with pytest.raises(TypeError):
+        cudnn.frost.cutedsl_runtime_available(bad)
+
+
+def test_arch_aware_probe_touches_the_dsl_only_for_a_cc107_part(dsl_state, monkeypatch):
+    dsl_state(True, (PUBLIC_DSL, "4.7.1"), False)
+    calls = []
+    monkeypatch.setattr(buffers, "_cutedsl_has_sm107", lambda: calls.append(1) or False)
+    assert cudnn.frost.cutedsl_runtime_available() is True
+    assert cudnn.frost.cutedsl_runtime_available((10, 0)) is True
+    assert calls == []  # neither the blind form nor another part asks the DSL
+    assert cudnn.frost.cutedsl_runtime_available((10, 7)) is False
+    assert calls == [1]
+
+
+# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
+# The torch dtype mapping
+# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+
+def test_torch_dtype_mapping_public_and_private_spellings_are_one_function():
+    assert datatypes.torch_to_cudnn_data_type is datatypes._torch_to_cudnn_data_type
+    assert list(inspect.signature(datatypes.torch_to_cudnn_data_type).parameters) == ["torch_data_type"]
+    assert datatypes.torch_to_cudnn_data_type(object()) is None  # an unmapped dtype is None, not an exception
+
+
+def test_torch_dtype_mapping_values():
+    torch = pytest.importorskip("torch")
+    f = datatypes.torch_to_cudnn_data_type
+    assert f(torch.bfloat16) is cudnn.data_type.BFLOAT16
+    assert f(torch.float16) is cudnn.data_type.HALF
+    assert f(torch.float32) is cudnn.data_type.FLOAT
+    assert f(torch.int32) is cudnn.data_type.INT32
+    assert f(torch.float8_e4m3fn) is cudnn.data_type.FP8_E4M3
+    assert f(torch.complex64) is None
+
+
+# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
+# import cudnn stays cheap; the docs name every public spelling
+# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+_HEAVY = ("torch", "cutlass", "nvidia_cutlass_dsl")
+
+
+def _modules_after(code: str) -> set:
+    probe = code + "\nimport json, sys; print('@@' + json.dumps(sorted(sys.modules)))"
+    run = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-c", probe], capture_output=True, text=True)
+    assert run.returncode == 0, f"probe failed: {run.stderr.strip()[-600:]}"
+    line = next(ln for ln in run.stdout.splitlines() if ln.startswith("@@"))
+    return set(json.loads(line[2:]))
+
+
+def test_import_cudnn_and_the_public_probes_pull_no_framework():
+    """The new public names cost no torch / DSL import: the capability set is read off the binder, the device-blind
+    probe and a non-cc-10.7 part read package metadata only (the cc 10.7 target check is the one DSL import)."""
+    code = (
+        "import cudnn\nimport cudnn.frost\ncudnn.sdpa_capabilities()\ncudnn.frost.cutedsl_runtime_available()\ncudnn.frost.cutedsl_runtime_available((10, 0))\n"
+    )
+    added = _modules_after(code) - _modules_after("")
+    present = sorted(m for m in _HEAVY if m in added)
+    assert not present, f"the public probes imported {present}; they must not"
+
+
+def test_the_docs_name_every_public_spelling():
+    docs = pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parents[4] / "docs" / "utilities" / "python_graph_and_execution_backends.md"
+    if not docs.is_file():
+        pytest.skip("the docs tree is not part of this checkout")
+    text = docs.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
+    assert "### Consumed by FlashInfer" in text
+    for name in (
+        "cudnn.sdpa_capabilities()",
+        "cudnn.frost.cutedsl_runtime_available(device_cc=None)",
+        "cudnn.datatypes.torch_to_cudnn_data_type",
+        "graph.selected_engine",
+        "graph.backend_plan_entries()",
+        "is_cuda_graph_replay_expected",
+        "4.8.0 on cc 10.7",
+    ):
+        assert name in text, name
